text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor m-u-l-t-i-p-l-i-e-d the f-o-l-d-e-r s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e to o-b-f-u-s-c-a-t-e the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g s-p-a-c-e while a-v-o-i-d-i-n-g the r-a-w e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e c-o-p-y
2) the item l-e-f-t o-n f-i-l-e was the b-a-c-k-u-p d-r-i-v-e of the f-a-c-i-a-l d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e which s-t-a-y-e-d u-n-t-o-u-c-h-e-d in the s-e-c-u-r-e c-o-l-d s-t-o-r-a-g-e b-a-y
3) the c-h-e-c-k-p-o-i-n-t n-o-t l-o-g-g-e-d was the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-a-g-e that c-o-n-f-i-r-m-s w-h-e-t-h-e-r the a-c-c-e-s-s t-o-k-e-n r-e-m-a-i-n-e-d v-a-l-i-d a-f-t-e-r the a-l-e-r-t
4) the p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l r-e-v-i-e-w n-o-t-e-d that the t-e-m-p-o-r-a-r-y p-a-s-s-c-o-d-e was r-o-t-a-t-e-d b-e-f-o-r-e the s-h-i-f-t c-h-a-n-g-e and the o-l-d k-e-y-s were r-e-t-i-r-e-d from the c-o-n-t-r-o-l p-a-n-e-l
5) the c-l-o-s-u-r-e s-t-a-t-e m-e-n-t-i-o-n-s the a-r-c-h-i-v-e was s-i-g-n-e-d by the o-n-c-a-l-l d-u-t-y s-u-p-e-r-v-i-s-o-r and the f-i-l-e is m-a-r-k-e-d as c-o-n-c-l-u-d-e-d with no o-p-e-n i-t-e-m-s
